blocks.text: Original document: [docs/ENTITY_SYSTEM.md](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/docs/ENTITY_SYSTEM.md). See [current limitations](/limitations) for concrete compatibility notes.
The Entity System is the heart of Retiam's scene management. It uses a composition-based approach where functionalities are added to base `Entity` objects via `Component`s.
The `Entity` class represents an object in the scene. It contains:

items: **Paint**: Visual properties like color, opacity, and stroke (handled via `Paint` class).
**Scene Graph**: Parent-child relationships for hierarchical transformations.
**Components**: A list of `Component` objects that define the entity's behavior and rendering.
`addComponent(component)`: Attaches a component to the entity.
`getComponent(type)`: Retrieves a component of a specific type.
`animate`: A getter that returns an `Animator` for the entity.
`always(callback)`: Adds a function to be executed every frame.

blocks.text: Functional components define how an entity behaves or is rendered.
Handles the geometric data of the entity (vertices, indices, etc.).
Defines how the entity is shaded.
Retiam provides a variety of built-in 2D shapes in `src/engine/entity/2d/shapes/Shapes.ts`:

items: `SVGPath`: For rendering complex paths from SVG data.
`Text`: For rendering text using Canvas or SDF.

blocks.text: 3D geometry is supported through `Geometry3D` and related components in `src/engine/entity/3d`.
To create a custom entity, you can either:

items: **Extend `Entity`**: Useful for complex objects with many parts.
**Compose via Components**: Add custom `Component` subclasses to a base `Entity`.
